In our experiments, we measure the quality of generated timelines with the following two evaluation metrics, which are also used by : • Alignment-based ROUGE F1-score: This metric compares the textual overlap between a system and a ground-truth timeline, while also considering the assignments of dates to texts. • Date F1-score: This metric compares only the dates of a system and a ground-truth timeline.
